assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: an original photorealistic garment base image sheet for a client logo-and-color mockup compositor.
Make ONE high-resolution landscape image, 2400×1600 pixels or the highest available landscape resolution. Show exactly TWO views of the SAME blank garment: perfect straight-on FRONT on the LEFT and perfect straight-on BACK on the RIGHT. Do not write front/back labels or any other text. Equal scale and vertical alignment. Each garment occupies its own half, with ample clean empty space between them. Whole garment and all sleeves fully inside frame, balanced margins all around.
Style: outstanding professional apparel e-commerce product photography with an invisible ghost mannequin technique. Real cotton fabric, naturally draped convincing soft folds, visible sewn seams and delicate weave texture, tiny natural fabric imperfections, realistic substantial cloth. No visible body, mannequin, hanger, stand or other object.
Color: neutral mid-light COOL GRAY fabric, approximately #a9adb4 in the evenly lit regions; all garment parts, threads, trims and accessories the same neutral gray. No tint or colored parts. The cloth texture and gentle light should provide useful tonal variation for recoloring.
Lighting: large softbox upper left and gentle fill, broad smooth natural fabric shading, visible rich but not crushed occlusion inside neck openings, no harsh highlights or specular plastic sheen.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT with actual alpha channel, not a checkerboard representation. If transparency is impossible, use perfectly pure solid white #ffffff with absolutely no backdrop, ground, cast, or contact shadow.
Avoid all text, lettering, labels, tags, brands, logos, symbols, decorative patterns, prints, UI, watermarks, visible humans, mannequins, hangers, harsh cast shadows, plastic CGI cloth, oversmoothing, dark gray garments, clipped sleeves, overlapping front and back. The image is a generic original garment, not a reproduction of any branded factory pattern.
Subject: a short-sleeved crew-neck cotton jersey T-shirt. Plain fine jersey knit body, round ribbed crew neck, visible subtle shoulder and side seams, double-stitched sleeve and bottom hems. Sleeves angle gently down about 25 degrees, with clear empty gaps under both sleeves, so front and rear silhouettes read cleanly. Both views have the same cut, hem length, sleeve length and cool gray color. No pockets.

Subject: a classic cotton-fleece pullover hoodie. FRONT view on left has a realistic hood opening, TWO simple gray drawstrings, a generous stitched kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and ribbed bottom hem. BACK view on right shows the same hood naturally resting against the upper back, with the visible characteristic drape and central hood seam; no pocket or drawstrings visible on back. Sleeves hang naturally down and slightly out, separated from torso below the armpits by clean empty gaps so the silhouette is readable. Medium substantial loopback cotton fleece with fine knit face; all cords and ribbing also identical neutral gray. Whole hood, sleeves and cuffs in frame.

Chifón long-sleeve crewneck photobase sheet (manga larga / zipneck body). Same front-left + back-right ghost-mannequin layout as the playera/hoodie/polo sheets. Neutral mid-gray, no logos, no zipper. Derived from Koke Chifón product reference (navy crewneck long-sleeve) and remapped to the existing tintable gray sheet format. v8.2.2 re-prep: interior alpha hardened and luminance scaled to the 0.66 tint reference so long sleeves recolor with the torso and white stain artifacts do not survive tinting.

Chifón men's sleeveless tank photobase sheet (sisada hombre, default sleeveless). Front-left + back-right ghost mannequin, deep armholes, hip-length hem, mid-gray, no logos. Derived from Koke Chifón men's muscle-tank reference. v8.2.3 re-prep: interior alpha hardened and luminance scaled to the 0.66 tint reference; runtime hardenSleevelessPhoto adds armhole/hem/side shading and a light-body contrast boost so #F4F3EF stays readable on the white studio background.

Chifón women's sleeveless crop photobase sheet (sisada mujer, alternate selectable cut). Front-left + back-right ghost mannequin, cropped waist hem, mid-gray, no brand marks. Derived from Koke Chifón women's crop reference with foreign logos omitted. v8.2.3 re-prep: same 0.66 luminance harden as the men's tank so the flat crop sheet keeps a visible silhouette when Cuerpo is white.

Subject: a classic short-sleeved cotton pique polo shirt. FRONT view on left has a proper ribbed folded collar, a neatly sewn three-button placket with exactly three neutral gray buttons, and subtle ribbed sleeve cuffs. BACK view on right shows the back of the folded collar, no placket and no buttons. Fine authentic micro waffle cotton pique texture. Sleeves angle gently down about 25 degrees with clear empty gaps under both sleeves; same shape, length, collar and cool gray color in both views. No chest pocket.
